desktop.vulkanMissing.body.pt-BR: O TradeLab precisa de um driver Vulkan para desenhar a janela e nenhum foi encontrado.
desktop.vulkanMissing.body.en: TradeLab needs a Vulkan driver to draw its window and none was found.

desktop.vulkanMissing.linux.pt-BR: Instale `libvulkan1` e o driver Vulkan da sua placa de vídeo (por exemplo `mesa-vulkan-drivers`) e abra o TradeLab de novo.
desktop.vulkanMissing.linux.en: Install `libvulkan1` and your graphics card's Vulkan driver (for example `mesa-vulkan-drivers`) and open TradeLab again.

desktop.vulkanMissing.macos.pt-BR: A instalação parece incompleta: baixe o TradeLab de novo.
desktop.vulkanMissing.macos.en: The installation looks incomplete: download TradeLab again.

desktop.crt.reducedMotion.pt-BR: O sistema pede movimento reduzido: o efeito CRT fica desligado.
desktop.crt.reducedMotion.en: The system asks for reduced motion: the CRT effect stays off.

desktop.about.fonts.pt-BR: Fontes: VT323 (títulos) e IBM Plex Mono (texto e números), ambas sob a SIL Open Font License 1.1.
desktop.about.fonts.en: Fonts: VT323 (titles) and IBM Plex Mono (text and numbers), both under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

desktop.chart.debrief.pt-BR: Gráfico da partida, da primeira decisão ao fim
desktop.chart.debrief.en: Chart of the run, from the first decision to the end
